title: Unified Executed Causal-Recovery Rubric for Human-Like Tool SFT
evaluation_unit: one fully executed trajectory, its private label-blind intervention sidecar, three causal counterfactual replays, and the batch-level reasoning-diversity audit

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: externalize policy state and train on actions that actually execute in the same Harness used at inference time
research_lineage.adaptation: candidate claims, field obligations, EvidenceAtoms, challenges, assessments, bindings, commitments, and terminal state are explicit and replayable

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: video deep research should be a multi-tool, multi-turn evidence acquisition process rather than one-shot answering
research_lineage.adaptation: dataset-specific measurements live behind one dependency-ordered action grammar

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: a correct final answer does not certify intermediate reasoning
research_lineage.adaptation: every positive SFT target must execute, create or consume visible state, and state its downstream consequence

research_lineage.source: counterfactual evaluation and causal data attribution
research_lineage.borrowed_principle: use interventions to distinguish causal steps from plausible narration
research_lineage.adaptation: clean-control, moved-defect, and fresh-evidence-removal probes accompany every recovery episode

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: training data must cover states induced by earlier mistakes, not only clean expert prefixes
research_lineage.adaptation: unannounced evidence corruption creates complete challenge-to-recovery suffixes without revealing a repair recipe

hard_gates.name: executed_safe_outcome
hard_gates.failure: Any positive target was not executed; a tool call was rejected; the final state is nonterminal; a required field is unsupported, conflicted, or uncommitted; or provenance remains open.

hard_gates.name: identity_scope_and_role_integrity
hard_gates.failure: Evidence belongs to another task/entity/role/scope, source and suspect coordinate frames are conflated, or logical IDs, media roles, and intervals are not supported by student-visible evidence.

hard_gates.name: control_plane_autonomy
hard_gates.failure: The student sees oracle values, verifier results, intervention names, restoration values, compiled target actions, materialized next-tool answers, or a categorical router answer.

hard_gates.name: complete_unannounced_recovery
hard_gates.failure: The policy misses a visible defect, challenges the wrong atom or fields, requests an unrelated check, fails to obtain fresh evidence, reuses superseded evidence, repairs unrelated fields, or stops before local recovery or principled abstention.

hard_gates.name: explicit_claim_value_revision
hard_gates.failure: Fresh evidence directly supports a different claim value but the trajectory silently preserves the stale value, changes a committed field without reopening it, revises a field without one unambiguous active visible support, or combines revision, binding, and commitment into one unverifiable action.

hard_gates.name: causal_counterfactual_response
hard_gates.failure: A clean control still challenges; moving the defect does not move the challenge target; deleting all fresh evidence still permits the same repair; or an irrelevant change alters independent fields.

hard_gates.name: reasoning_target_integrity
hard_gates.failure: Any assistant target has empty reasoning, truncation/placeholder artifacts, no student-visible grounding, no explanation of the action's state consequence, an implausible length, or the batch exceeds the declared duplication/concentration limits.
hard_gates.why_ordinary_tests_are_insufficient: The v2 compiler executed and passed structural counterfactual checks while every fresh_binding target serialized content=null. Type/schema checks validate tool arguments, not the pedagogical content of assistant text; therefore an explicit reasoning-content audit is required.

hard_gates.name: independent_blind_review
hard_gates.failure: Fewer than two blind judges review the student-visible trajectories, a dimension mean is below 4/5, or a score disagreement above one point remains unadjudicated.

required_action_grammar: detect a concrete student-visible integrity defect
challenge named active EvidenceAtoms with the minimal affected field subset
execute the requested real context or measurement tool
name the resulting fresh EvidenceAtoms and explain what they change or preserve
when a fresh atom uniquely supports a different value, explicitly revise only the reopened field
when active evidence competes, assess every candidate and adjudicate the exact partition
bind only fresh active evidence compatible with the current claim values
request stop only after all high-priority obligations close

allowed_only_when: an evidence challenge has resolved through a real fresh observation
the target field is already open
one unambiguous active non-superseded EvidenceAtom directly states and supports the proposed new value
no unresolved multi-atom conflict requires adjudication
must_not: infer a value from private intervention metadata
bind evidence or commit the decision in the same action

required: no replacement-character, ellipsis-truncation, TODO, TBD, or placeholder artifact
student-visible EvidenceAtom, field value, obligation, or binding grounding appropriate to the stage
an explicit explanation of why the chosen action changes the next executable state
automated_reasoning_audit.scope_limit: This audit detects missing, ungrounded, truncated, and heavily templated text; it does not replace blind human judgment of factual adequacy or naturalness.

causal_neighborhood.clean_control: Removing the visible defect must suppress challenge_evidence.
causal_neighborhood.moved_defect: Moving the same defect to another active atom must move the challenge target and preserve unrelated dependencies.
causal_neighborhood.fresh_evidence_removal: Deleting all newly produced evidence must make the same repaired binding impossible.
